Despite building a global procedure base, Asensus faced persistent financial difficulties and going-concern doubts, ultimately being acquired by KARL STORZ in 2024. The acquisition marked the end of Asensus as an independent entity, with its Senhance technology now folded into KARL STORZ's broader surgical portfolio. Asensus Surgical fell victim to a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 600 GB of data and over 85,000 files containing confidential information, employees’ personal documents, research findings, and all of the company’s internal information.
